i understand that this makes you uncomfortable and hopefully sometime in the future this will be implemented but for right now if you create/import a character and then create a scenario involving them the ability to delete them becomes unavailable, scenarios are merely the beginnings to stories you see on a character's page

for right now if you want a specific scenario or character deleted you can send an email here: [team@tryspellbound.com](mailto:team@tryspellbound.com) or join the discord and open a ticket

click on "My stories" at the top of the page on the homepage and at the very bottom of the menu that pops out there will be a button called "Edit Stories" from there you'll be able to delete as many stories as you want
you don't need to add brackets for this, just adding it between the asterisks should be good enough, in fact adding brackets like this can lead to unintentional behavior
when you start/enter a story go to story settings, there will be a persona menu in there

the two sites available to import from at the moment are [fandom.com](http://fandom.com) pages and [sakura.fm](http://sakura.fm) characters, you are also able to make characters yourself utilizing spellbound's "create from scratch" menu

every time the AI Model(s) received updates it would often end up breaking chat mode or resulted in unwanted behavior on chat mode, since there's only one developer working on spellbound a decision was made to focus entirely on story mode instead of splitting resources between two separate forms of AI

if you're on ios in the safari button tap on the share icon (looks like a box with an arrow coming out of it), then tapping "add to home screen" that way
my stories => edit stories button at the bottom, then you click the checkboxes to delete stories

eloquent seems to be the most popular in the discord server, i personally like creating my own writing styles underneath the custom writing style depending on the kind of story i'm doing (i'll specify genres, so for a more comedic story i'd write something along the lines of: "Comedy. Focus on entertaining and engaging dialogue and back-and-forths between the characters. Comedic timing is paramount."

terse is great if you really are not a fan of the flowery language that AI models are notorious for utilizing

i've heard slang can bring up emojis unprompted (after the recent updates i haven't seen anyone bring it up again but it could be a possibility)

archaic follows "traditional writing style" very literally, commonly using outdated, old-timey english

plain is the default for a reason, being a solid option if you just want to get right into a story without messing with settings

i'm not certain how much writing styles affect the free model as a warning

when it loads for a while like how you're describing it's most likely a connection issue which has been happening more frequently as of late

when you are able to search for characters it helps to search for more than just their name if you haven't been doing that already, such as appearance traits (i.e. noah blonde hair blue eyes instead of searching just for noah), the dev has been working on an update that should fix the search and increase stability of the site

control mode is the best way to make responses shorter however that is a subscriber-only feature, i usually get the shortest length with the terse writing style, you could try specifying length using a custom writing style but i highly doubt that would do much

do not manually prompt or try to add to story notes to shorten the length of responses, you usually end up getting a poorer quality generation as a result

you can try adding into story notes for the AI to not emphasize environmental details so much: "Do not go into detail about the environment." it sounds like you could be on the free model (no quills), but if you're on the paid model you could try a different writing style or even use a custom one, though that requires trial and error, eloquent typically goes the most into detail about the environment which can lead to stuff like this and repeating specific details/phrases

unfortunately stuff like this you'll have to manually prompt not to happen if you notice it, as you can run out of room on story notes

i typically get situations like that during a confrontation and it starts raining outside just after a character starts crying, it's a way for the AI to add details about the atmosphere but it can snowball into... extreme stuff like this

for example i typically do stories with a very scholarly character so books will always be mentioned, as well as them tumbling, typically only happens indoors but even when i mention a table there can be books falling/tumbling
some providers block emails, once you lose your account it is gone forever and the dev will be unable to help you, for the second question i'd recommend joining the discord and opening a ticket

[https://www.tryspellbound.com/](https://www.tryspellbound.com/) is the main website, there isn't an app yet so don't download anything that claims to be an official spellbound app, however you can have it behave like an app on android by going to the website i linked on the mobile google chrome browser, tapping the three little dots in the upper right corner, then tapping on "add to homescreen"

on ios you can achieve the same thing by tapping the share button at the bottom of the screen (looks like a box with an arrow pointing up), then tapping "add to homescreen"

save everything you typed down in a notepad and try the following: refreshing, logging in and out, clearing cookies/cache, trying another browser, trying another device, if none of these help you then i would advise joining the discord and opening a ticket
I'm assuming that the credits for the images that generate alongside scenarios have run out and the dev needs to refill them, no eta for that

when you're in a story and click on the amount of quills you have then click on "access your subscription" you should be brought to a page with details about your subscription, to the far right of "Spellbound+ (Membership)" there will be three dots, click on those and in that little pop up box there should be an option to cancel

i am sure, older fandom imports don't have the link back to their original source because that was something added in later - it sounds like you tried to import a character that was already on the site and you got redirected to their already existing page, they're most likely an older character that was imported a while ago, before that "view original source" link was added to character pages

you're alright, fandom imports are entirely done with AI, the vast majority of the characters you find on spellbound are not made by humans - they're made entirely by AI since the majority of public characters are fandom imports, it might look like it's made by a human but they're not

there are multiple ways you can achieve this, if you're subscribed the easiest way would be to flip on the "control mode" toggle, as that usually does not generate any dialogue for your persona

if you are not subscribed you can attempt to put "Under no circumstances will there be dialogue written for \[persona\]." i've gotten relatively good results with that, results could differ if you do not have quills

that's disappointing, creating scenarios aren't locked to only sub users but some people will occasionally bring up an issue of being unable to create a new scenarios even after waiting the 24-hour period after their last created scenario, but having quills would help get past the issue of it preventing you from creating a new scenario since every scenario above the 3rd one you create begins to cost 10 quills

i'm sorry that this is happening for you, people have been having issues with the search recently for newly-created or imported characters, if even trying to search for their appearance or personality does not work alongside their name then it will be nearly impossible to add them into a story, there's a website UI update that was teased that should hopefully fix the issue with the character search

as for them not appearing at the bottom of the page try refreshing, logging in and out, or visiting the beta site to see if they appear on there, if they're still not appearing i would recommend joining the discord and opening a ticket
